title: LEGO Has Produced 10 Billion Minifigures
hook: LEGO's cumulative minifigure count reached 10 billion.
closing: The comparison is striking, but production totals are not a census of surviving toys.
question: How many minifigures do you own?

segments.say: LEGO has produced 10 billion minifigures cumulatively. That total spans decades, unlike a count of people alive now.
By 2019, LEGO had made 8.3 billion minifigures. The total reflects decades of accumulated production.
LEGO produces 400 million minifigures yearly. New figures arrive faster than the comparison group shown.
